Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Celebrating a Photography Award and Planning a Vacation Trip
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your close friend, Dan, who recently won first prize in a national photography contest. Read part of his email below:

"I have some wonderful news to share—I just won first prize in the National Youth Photography Competition! As part of the award, I received a 4-day travel vacation voucher, and I would love for you to come with me to the award ceremony and join the trip afterwards! Could you let me know what day and time you can arrive? During our stay, would you prefer staying at a cozy local homestay or a 4-star hotel? Also, what exciting activities or sightseeing spots would you like us to do together while we are there?"

Write an email responding to Dan.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Education is the Key to the Future
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"It is widely believed that education is the key to the future, empowering individuals to achieve personal success and enabling nations to develop sustainably."

Write an essay to an educated reader explaining the importance of education for individuals and society. Provide specific reasons and examples from your knowledge or personal experience to support your view.
title: Task 2.1: Education is the Key to the Future
content:
Read the following statement:

"It is widely believed that education is the key to the future, empowering individuals to achieve personal success and enabling nations to develop sustainably."

Write an essay to an educated reader explaining the importance of education for individuals and society. Provide specific reasons and examples from your knowledge or personal experience to support your view.

body1.example: For instance, my brother was struggling to find a stable office job right after high school. Therefore, he decided to attend university and earn a B2 English certificate. As a result, he finally got hired by an international company with a much higher salary. If he had not invested time in his education, he would not have been able to build such a good career.
body1.focus: Lợi ích cho cá nhân: Kiến thức, kỹ năng nghề nghiệp và mức sống
body1.frame: Mở: First and foremost, people should recognize that education helps individuals gain practical skills and better jobs | Ruột ĐOẠN 1 | Chốt: Clearly, building practical skills for individuals brings undeniable value in modern life.
body1.point: A very important point to consider is that education plays an essential role in helping people broaden their mind and learn practical job skills. This means that young people with good degrees have more opportunities to find well-paid jobs and improve their living standard. Another point I would like to make is that schooling trains learners to think carefully and solve daily problems. This is because of the fact that classes and group projects teach both subject knowledge and useful life habits.

body2.example: For example, I was worried about how much plastic waste people left in our neighborhood park last year. For this reason, I got to join a school environmental project that educated local families on sorting trash. If I had not taken part in that school program, I would not have been able to know that simple education can change a whole community.
body2.focus: Lợi ích cho xã hội: Phát triển kinh tế, khoa học và ý thức cộng đồng
body2.frame: Mở: Secondly, there are further arguments in support of the idea that education boosts economic development and improves society | Ruột ĐOẠN 2 | Chốt: It is clear that boosting economic development and social awareness plays an important role.
body2.point: In fact, educated citizens help a country keep pace with the fast-paced development of modern science and boost economic development. This happens because when a nation has skilled doctors, teachers, and engineers, it easily leads to stronger businesses, better healthcare, and cleaner cities. In addition, education raises public awareness of healthy lifestyles, fair rules, and environmental protection.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, I strongly agree that education is the key to the future, mainly because it helps build practical skills for individuals and supports economic and social development. Therefore, both individuals and schools should work together to make the most of lifelong education responsibly.
